title: extensions.topology
description: Whether a graph saved in mapped storage reads its topology and index sections in place once the server opens a v9 .kgl file. 'storage' is 'auto' (the default) or 'mapped' (both read the sections in place from a regular local file; Windows copies them) or 'memory' (ignore the sections, decode the compressed topology and rebuild the indexes). The --topology flag overrides it. The setting is runtime only and never written into a .kgl file; a v8 or older file and an in-memory graph ignore it.
